race.comment: STUNTMAN (7) resumes. He showed good ability in two runs last time in, placing behind Plunger on debut in a Future Stars Heat who went on to win the series. He was well backed in a strong maiden next time out and has won a jumpout leading in, go close. ROCKZINO (12) is a filly by Tarzino on debut for the Grahame Begg yard. She's won a jumpout leading in and the yard are always dangerous with their debutants. ANGLAND LASS (9) is a filly by Ace High on debut for the Hayes yard, related to the handy Angland. She won a recent jumpout in good style and just needs a good ride from the gate to take beating. TOP CONTI (8) ran well first up at Pakenham Synthetic and should come on from that. He maps ideally and will take catching with that run under the belt. LOLLIE'S GALORE (3) resumes with claims off two solid runs last time in.
